behavior_summary: IDLE selects hazard flashing before either turn signal. Each turn signal alternates between its ON and OFF states when phase_expired is true, while a canceled request returns to IDLE and an enabled hazard request takes priority. In either hazard phase, disabling hazards selects a requested left or right signal, or IDLE when no turn is requested. While hazards remain enabled, timer expiration alternates HAZARD_ON and HAZARD_OFF. Only the ON states drive their corresponding indicator outputs.
